name: Isotropic Gaussian Point-Sprite Rendering
definition: A rendering technique using isotropic 3D point primitives with a Gaussian alpha falloff in screen space, rendered via custom GLSL shaders in Three.js. It demonstrates soft Gaussian opacity and transparency but does not implement full 3D Gaussian Splatting (no anisotropic covariance, no spherical harmonics, no GPU tile-based rasterization).
summary: Isotropic Gaussian Point-Sprite Rendering uses custom GLSL shaders to render soft Gaussian opacity with CPU-side back-to-front sorting to correct alpha blending order.
